svg.text: Snapshot of Runtime Object Instances During 32-Second Sustained High Pressure Alert & Mobile Escalation

g.text: message = "Educational prototype alert: Sustained high pressure."
advice = "Sustained high pressure detected for 32 seconds. Please check the STEP-SAFE dashboard."
RUNTIME SCENARIO CONTEXT — 32-SECOND SUSTAINED HIGH PRESSURE EVENT:
• Zero-Load Calibration Completed: 20 samples yielded FSR baseline of 150 (threshold = 180) and temperature baseline of 32.5 °C (threshold = 34.5 °C).
• Sustained Pressure Rule Triggered: Patient applied sustained stance; FSR reading rose to 680 (exceeding threshold of 180). Timer ran past 30 seconds (current value: 32s).
• High Pressure Classification: Temperature reading is 33.0 °C (below 34.5 °C threshold), classifying this condition as HIGH PRESSURE (elevated temp would escalate to HIGH RISK).
• Local & Remote Escalation: ESP32 activated local piezo buzzer on GPIO 25; Flask backend recorded Event #501 in SQLite events table and dispatched notification #901 via Firebase/APNs.

• Notification Delivery: notification01 dispatched via Firebase/APNs Mobile Notification Service to Patient and Caregiver profiles: "Sustained high pressure detected for 32 seconds. Please check the STEP-SAFE dashboard."
